aboutPage.title: About NEV Climate Data
aboutPage.subtitle: A data infrastructure serving climate decision-making in Africa.
aboutPage.mission: NEV Climate Data's mission is to collect, structure and share climate and funding data across the African continent, to provide a reliable, consistent and accessible information base for public decision-makers, funders, researchers and civil society organizations.
aboutPage.problem: Climate funding data is currently scattered across multiple institutions - multilateral banks, international funds, national agencies - published in heterogeneous formats that are rarely comparable with one another. This fragmentation makes any cross-cutting analysis difficult: tracking the real evolution of financial flows, comparing countries with one another, or measuring the impact of investments on the ground.
aboutPage.obj1: Centralize climate and funding data from recognized official sources.
aboutPage.obj2: Structure this data using a common reference framework (country, sector, year, funding type) to make it comparable.
aboutPage.obj3: Guarantee the traceability and validation status of every piece of data shared.
aboutPage.obj4: Make this data accessible via a clear interface and a documented API.
aboutPage.why: A climate investment decision - public or private - is only as good as the data that informs it. By precisely documenting the origin, reliability and validation status of every record, NEV Climate Data seeks to clearly distinguish demonstration data from verified data, a necessary condition for the responsible use of information in decision-making.
aboutPage.vision: To become a trusted reference for climate funding analysis in Africa - an open, structured and sustainable data infrastructure, useful to institutions, researchers and citizens alike.
apiDocsPage.subtitle: Integrate NEV Climate Data into your applications via the REST API.
apiDocsPage.overview: The NEV Climate Data API exposes the platform's climate and funding data in JSON format, under the /api prefix. Authentication, access keys, search, funding data, analytics and reports are all operational; see the Swagger / OpenAPI documentation below for the full reference.
apiDocsPage.swaggerNote: Link relative to the backend (/api/doc) - served by the same server as the API, generated automatically from the code (NelmioApiDocBundle).
apiDocsPage.jwtDesc: A user account authenticates with credentials (email / password) to obtain a short-lived access token and a refresh token.
apiDocsPage.apiKeysDesc: Once logged in, a user can generate their own API keys for programmatic access via the X-API-Key header, without a JWT token.
apiDocsPage.apiKeyNote: The raw key is only shown once, at creation - it must be saved immediately.
apiDocsPage.exampleNote: Data endpoints (funding, search, analytics, reports) are in production - see the Swagger / OpenAPI documentation for the full reference of each.
